description: This is a Go source file implementing a file processing pipeline for translating documentation files with front matter handling, HTML block translation, and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Main function to process a documentation file, translating front matter and HTML content, utilizing caching, and saving translated output.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits content into front matter and body sections based on YAML delimiters.

methods.name: encodeFrontMatter
methods.description: Encodes front matter data back into a YAML string with added metadata.

methods.name: translateFrontMatter
methods.description: Translates specific front matter fields such as title, summary, and read_when using a translation service.

methods.name: translateSnippet
methods.description: Translates a snippet of text, utilizing cache to avoid redundant translations.
